A FEW GOOD ANSWERS

Before you ask.

Need something else? We’re a message away.

How do I place an order?

Add your product to the cart, enter your delivery details, then open WhatsApp and press Send. This is an order request. HALDEN confirms your order manually.

What’s included in the whitening-strips pack?

The listed GLORYSMILE product is the 14-strip, 7-day pack at PKR 2,300. Follow the directions and precautions on the original packaging.

How much is delivery?

Delivery charges and estimated timing are confirmed directly by HALDEN on WhatsApp. The cart shows the product subtotal before delivery.

Can I buy clothing and accessories yet?

Clothing and accessories are coming soon. The current catalogue includes GLORYSMILE whitening strips at PKR 2,300, a 2-in-1 golden facial hair remover at PKR 1,799, and BoneBrothPK Beef Tallow Balm Moisturiser at PKR 3,499. Delivery and availability are confirmed by HALDEN; the balm blend must also be confirmed before order acceptance.

Can I pay on this website?

No payment is collected on this website. HALDEN confirms payment arrangements directly with you on WhatsApp.
